mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (client_id, user_id, first_name, last_name, system_role, image_url, salary) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{userId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{systemRole}, #{imageUrl}, #{salary})
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, system_role = #{systemRole}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, salary = #{salary}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, system_role = #{systemRole}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, salary = #{salary}, delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE client_id = #{request.clientId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_employees te WHERE te.employee_id = e.client_id AND te.team_code = #{criteria.teamCode} AND te.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value})
